source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of collaborative tools (PDF 211-212).

blocks.text: Collaborative tools kai logon ko ek saath plan par kaam aur foran raye dene dete hain. Bake karne wale dost ke saath bakery kholte waqt aap dono Google Drive ya Dropbox Paper mein ek hi document edit kar sakte hain: saathi products aur recipes likhta jabke aap marketing plan aur maali andaza likhte hain. Comment aur suggestion modes text badle baghair tabdeeli tajweez karne dete, aur version history tabdeeliyan dekhne aur purane drafts par wapas jane deti hai.

blocks.prompt: Mushtarak plan mein version history kyun mufeed hai?
blocks.explanation: Agar koi tabdeeli ghalat ho ya ghalti se mit jaye to dekh sakte hain kis ne kya badla aur purana version wapas la sakte hain.

items: Collaboration tools: mil kar edit, comment, suggest, versions ka record (Google Drive, Dropbox Paper).
